Name: sapdme_ebr
Title: Electronic Batch Record
Description: Electronic batch records (EBRs) are digital systems used in manufacturing to document, guide, and track each step of a batch in real time, replacing paper-based records. EBRs help you improve accuracy, compliance, and efficiency by reducing manual errors, enforcing standardized procedures, and making data easier to review, audit, and analyze.
